name: feature-flow
description: An end-to-end feature workflow as a single plugin: brainstorm options, write a medium-weight spec, audit umbrellas for coherence, implement the spec (solo, via a team of agents, or as a scripted dynamic workflow), then document what shipped. Five sibling skills (feature-brainstorm, feature-spec, feature-spec-audit, feature-implement, doc-generator) that share conventions and reference assets — install once, get the whole flow.
